summary: Exercise durable browser outbox crash boundaries in hosted web CI

replay.detail: The browser harness asserts that unresolved dispatched attempts never produce another action POST after page-owner loss. No production replay behavior changes.

schema.detail: No browser or server storage schema changes. The fixture HTTP peer uses canonical schema-checked protocol envelopes.

compatibility.detail: Production behavior is unchanged. The test-only Vite entry exercises real chat and thread Start senders, browser IndexedDB, receipt validation and recovery UI.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or restart is required.

manual.detail: No operator action or browser installation is required for deployed clients.

recovery.detail: Crash tests verify exact prepared-packet persistence, unknown delivery after permit consumption or network activity, explicit revalidation of pending attempts, and single dispatch across two tabs. Receipt-before-local-commit remains unknown because no original-member correlated outcome-read capability is available. The HTTP peer is a protocol fixture, not proof of real daemon effects or restart; page close does not prove operating-system crash or power-loss durability.
